dedupe_keys.name: clim recal uk climate bias correction pipeline

description: clim-recal is an Alan Turing Institute pipeline for extracting UKCP18 convection-permitting climate projections and comparing bias-correction methods against HadUK-Grid observations. It prepares regional climate arrays, applies correction choices and produces adjusted or diagnostic outputs. Users supply the UKCP18 and HadUK-Grid products, region, variable and method settings; outputs are corrected fields or evaluation measures for the selected UK period. Geographic coverage is the United Kingdom where the source products overlap. MIT source and repository workflow documentation are public. The README says a broader plugin framework for new correction methods is planned, not complete. A limitation is that a corrected mean or distribution does not prove improved local extremes; users need event-specific validation. clim-recal can prepare rainfall or heat inputs for drainage, transport and building simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 record is a different climate product. No licensed climate files or package were downloaded.
name: clim-recal UK climate bias-correction pipeline
